milestone: M56 Arbitrary Repository Coding Golden Journey

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: headless.continue_once can now consume a verified objective apply verification checkpoint and record explicit objective completion acceptance without caller-side ledger interpretation.
The runtime requires explicit objective completion acceptance authorization and rejects stale or mismatched verification evidence before recording acceptance.
The Golden Journey gains a replay-safe route from verified objective apply evidence into accepted completion, rather than stopping at a verification route suggestion.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with direct support for persistent_structured_ledger, agent_loop, and runtime_permission_enforcement.
answers.new_capability: A headless caller can provide objective_completion_acceptance_target to headless.continue_once and have Rust validate a verified M56.5 checkpoint, persist bounded acceptance evidence, and route the Golden Journey toward closure.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M56.5 only emits accept_objective_completion_explicitly after hash verification. It does not consume that route, require explicit acceptance authorization, or record durable accepted objective completion evidence.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: The arbitrary-repository Golden Journey can apply and verify a workspace edit but remains unable to finish from bounded runtime proof.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M56.3 authorization/preflight, M56.4 apply, and M56.5 verification because this phase consumes the verified acceptance route and records completion acceptance.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The implementation extends existing headless.continue_once params and routing; it adds no JSON-RPC method.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It adds no report, digest, history, verdict, readiness, inspection, preview, or dashboard surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Rust validates objective completion acceptance authorization, current progress, M56.5 verification checkpoint identity, route kind, status, hashes, and replay fingerprint before recording bounded acceptance evidence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: The scheduled controller can continue from verified workspace mutation to accepted objective completion without manually reading ledger details or file content.
answers.milestone_progress: This closes the acceptance gap after M56.5 verification and brings M56 close to milestone closeout or one final distinct closure step.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts a bounded objective_completion_acceptance_target for accept_objective_completion_explicitly routes

Rust validates the M56.5 verification checkpoint decision id, journey/session/drive/task/run/proposal/apply ids, operation/status labels, path/apply/current-target hashes, verification status, route kind, and verification fingerprint
Missing authorization, stale progress, mismatch evidence, non-verified status, and conflicting replay fail before acceptance mutation
Successful acceptance writes bounded completion acceptance checkpoint and HeadlessContinuationDecisionRecorded evidence
Exact replay returns the same bounded decision without duplicate ledger events or checkpoint mutation

Ledger/checkpoint/RPC payloads exclude raw prompts, provider responses, file content, diffs, stdout/stderr, commands, environment, raw requests, raw ledger payloads, absolute/canonical paths, secrets, and raw tokens
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test headless_continue_applies_objective_proposal_after_authorization_preflight_and_replays covers objective completion acceptance success, authorization denial, bounded checkpointing, and duplicate-free replay
cargo check --workspace validates protocol/runtime/store integration for objective completion acceptance target and checkpoint types
VSIX protocol tests accept bounded objective completion acceptance params and reject malformed or raw-data-bearing payloads

safety_boundary: uses existing M56.5 objective apply verification checkpoint evidence
requires explicit objective completion acceptance authorization
stores bounded hashes, identifiers, route, status, and sequence metadata only
non_goals: no shell, git, network, provider, service, scheduler, or daemon execution
rejected_alternatives: caller-side ledger interpretation after M56.5 verification
direct acceptance without verified checkpoint evidence
adding a completion report or inspection endpoint
persisting raw file content, diffs, raw requests, commands, paths, or environment in acceptance evidence
technical_debt: A following phase_complete assessment must decide whether M56 can close or whether one distinct closure route remains.
Runtime lib.rs remains large and should be split only by a later behavior-preserving MOVE-only refactor.
next_capability_rationale: If objective completion acceptance supplies terminal Golden Journey closure, proceed to M56 closeout; otherwise plan one distinct closure phase.
